title: Adapter flags derived from the installed agent version
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Probe each agent's --help/version and choose supported flags (trust, output format, headless mode) instead of static argv in the catalog. Tests zc_agent_flags_* with recorded help output.
